tools.name: align.apply
tools.description: Align or distribute the selected objects.

action.description: One of: left, center-h, right, top, middle-v, bottom, dist-h, dist-v, dist-center-h, dist-center-v, dist-left, dist-right, dist-top, dist-bottom.

relativeTo.description: Align relative to the selection bounds or the active artboard.

tools.name: arrange.bringForward
tools.description: Bring the selection forward one step.

tools.name: arrange.bringToFront
tools.description: Bring the selection to the front of its stack.

tools.name: arrange.sendBackward
tools.description: Send the selection backward one step.

tools.name: arrange.sendToBack
tools.description: Send the selection to the back of its stack.

tools.name: doc.open
tools.description: Open a document from disk, replacing the current one — the same loader File ▸ Open uses (.mart and any Monet container, .svg/.svgz, .ai/.eps/.ps, .pdf, .cdr). Native desktop only.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to open.

tools.name: edit.redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone change.

tools.name: edit.undo
tools.description: Undo the last change.

tools.name: layer.add
tools.description: Add a new empty layer above the active one and make it active.

tools.name: layer.delete
tools.description: Delete the active layer and its items (never the last remaining layer).

tools.name: layer.duplicate
tools.description: Duplicate the active layer (and its items) above it.

tools.name: layer.flatten
tools.description: Flatten all layers into the active one, preserving stacking order.

tools.name: object.delete
tools.description: Delete the selected objects.

tools.name: object.duplicate
tools.description: Duplicate the selected objects in place.

tools.name: object.expand
tools.description: Expand the selection — convert live shapes to paths and outline strokes.

tools.name: object.group
tools.description: Group the selected objects (needs 2 or more).

tools.name: object.ungroup
tools.description: Ungroup the selected groups.

tools.name: path.offset
tools.description: Create an offset copy of each selected object.

distance.description: Offset distance in points; negative insets.

tools.name: path.outlineStroke
tools.description: Outline the strokes of the selection into filled paths.

tools.name: path.reverse
tools.description: Reverse the direction of each selected path.

tools.name: path.roundCorners
tools.description: Round the sharp corners of each selected object into circular fillets.

tools.name: path.simplify
tools.description: Reduce the anchor count of each selected path while keeping its shape.

tolerance.description: Simplification tolerance in points; higher removes more.

tools.name: pathfinder.apply
tools.description: Combine the selected objects (2 or more) with a Pathfinder operation.

op.description: One of: unite, minus-front, intersect, exclude, minus-back, divide, trim, merge, crop, outline.

tools.name: select.all
tools.description: Select every selectable object in the document.

tools.name: select.inverse
tools.description: Invert the selection — select every selectable object that isn't selected.

tools.name: select.none
tools.description: Deselect everything.

tools.name: transform.reflectHorizontal
tools.description: Reflect (mirror) the selection horizontally about its centre.

tools.name: transform.reflectVertical
tools.description: Reflect (mirror) the selection vertically about its centre.

tools.name: transform.rotate90Ccw
tools.description: Rotate the selection 90 degrees counter-clockwise around its centre.

tools.name: transform.rotate90Cw
tools.description: Rotate the selection 90 degrees clockwise around its centre.

tools.name: transparency.blendMode
tools.description: Set the blend mode on the selection.

mode.description: One of: normal, multiply, screen, overlay, darken, lighten, color-dodge, color-burn, hard-light, soft-light, difference, exclusion, hue, saturation, color, luminosity.
